en_title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's Lead Writer Has Left Sandfall to Help Game Devs Tell Better Stories
cn_title: 《光与影：33号远征队》首席编剧已离开Sandfall，帮助游戏开发者讲述更好的故事
opus_summary: 《光与影：33号远征队》首席编剧Jennifer Svedberg-Yen已离开Sandfall，正筹建基金，旨在推动游戏叙事设计并培养新编剧。她认为，游戏从一开始就重视叙事，有助于各个开发领域相互配合。她还透露，自己有几个电视项目的想法。

paragraphs.en: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ’s lead writer has left Sandfall to help other game developers think about story from the outset. Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, the narrative lead for Expedition 33, won a BAFTA Breakthrough U.S. award earlier this year, and she’s since been consulting on stories across the industry.
paragraphs.cn: 《光与影：33号远征队》的首席编剧已离开Sandfall，以帮助其他游戏开发者从一开始就考虑故事。《光与影：33号远征队》的叙事负责人Jennifer Svedberg-Yen今年早些时候获得了英国电影学院突破奖美国奖项，此后一直在游戏行业提供故事咨询。

paragraphs.en: Expedition 33 was her first video game (she came from a career in private equity), but it won more than 400 awards and received almost universal critical acclaim, in part due to its blend of real-time and traditional turn-based RPG mechanics, and partly because of its mysterious story, strong emotional beats, and brilliant characters.
paragraphs.cn: 《光与影：33号远征队》是她参与的第一款电子游戏（她此前从事私募股权投资工作），但这款游戏赢得了400多个奖项，几乎获得了评论界的一致好评，部分原因是它融合了即时制和传统回合制RPG机制，也部分归功于其神秘的故事、强烈的情感节奏和出色的角色。

paragraphs.en: Svedberg-Yen is now setting up a fund with the aim of advancing narrative design in video games and nurturing new writing talent.
paragraphs.cn: Svedberg-Yen目前正在设立一项基金，旨在推动电子游戏叙事设计的发展并培养新的编剧人才。

paragraphs.en: “I feel that we are losing so much institutional knowledge,” Svedberg-Yen told GamesBeat . “We’re making it extraordinarily difficult for a younger generation of developers to have formative experiences. There’s so much disruption in the industry right now.”
paragraphs.cn: Svedberg-Yen告诉GamesBeat：「我觉得我们正在失去大量的行业经验积累。我们让年轻一代开发者获得成长所需的经历变得异常困难。目前行业里有太多动荡。」

paragraphs.en: Outside of the constant layoffs and upheaval in the industry, there’s also a sense, still, that narrative isn’t as respected as other parts of game design.
paragraphs.cn: 除了行业内不断发生的裁员和动荡，人们仍然感觉叙事不像游戏设计的其他部分那样受到重视。

paragraphs.en: “A lot of studios think of narrative as a skin,” Svedberg-Yen said. “They think you can bring someone in later to make everything make sense.
paragraphs.cn: Svedberg-Yen说：「很多工作室认为叙事只是一层外皮。他们觉得可以晚些时候找个人来，让一切变得合情合理。

paragraphs.en: “But when you start from the beginning, everyone is building from the same story and the different disciplines naturally reinforce each other.”
paragraphs.cn: 「但当你从一开始就着手时，每个人都在围绕同一个故事进行创作，不同专业领域自然会相互强化。」

paragraphs.en: The award-winning writer believes this approach limits what games can achieve. Expedition 33 was designed with a narrative-first approach, with the game systems built around the story to reinforce the themes and pace the big moments out.
paragraphs.cn: 这位获奖编剧认为，这种做法限制了游戏能够取得的成就。《光与影：33号远征队》采用叙事优先的方式设计，游戏系统围绕故事构建，以强化主题并安排重大情节的节奏。

paragraphs.en: “Narrative was king,” she said. “It was always a narrative-first game. I think that’s why we were able to achieve the results that we did in terms of integrating all the different pieces into a wonderful collaborative whole. There was that consistency from the very beginning.”
paragraphs.cn: 她说：「叙事至上。这始终是一款叙事优先的游戏。我认为这就是我们能够将所有不同部分融合成一个精彩的协作整体并取得这些成果的原因。从一开始就保持着这种一致性。」

paragraphs.en: According to Svedberg-Yen, she’s received messages from players about how Expedition 33 helped them deal with grief and navigate the world after suffering a personal loss.
paragraphs.cn: 据Svedberg-Yen称，她收到过玩家的来信，讲述《光与影：33号远征队》如何帮助他们在遭受个人失去之痛后应对悲伤、继续面对世界。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, it doesn’t seem like we’ll see more of Svedberg-Yen’s work in video games any time soon. Outside of the fund, she has a couple of ideas for TV, but she left Sandfall in July “after wrapping up some final stuff for Expedition.”
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，我们近期似乎不会看到更多Svedberg-Yen参与的电子游戏作品。除了这项基金，她还有几个电视剧方面的想法，但她在「完成《光与影：33号远征队》的一些最后工作后」于7月离开了Sandfall。

paragraphs.en: Following success at pretty much every major video game award show (most recently including scooping up Best Game at the BAFTA Awards ), Sandfall Interactive is now busy planning its next project. Details of that currently remain under wraps, though the suggestion is that it will be another adventure set in the same Clair Obscur universe .
paragraphs.cn: 在几乎所有主要电子游戏颁奖典礼上取得成功后（最近还包括斩获英国电影学院奖最佳游戏奖），Sandfall Interactive现在正忙于筹划下一个项目。目前该项目的细节仍处于保密状态，不过有迹象表明，这将是另一场以同一个《光与影》宇宙为背景的冒险。

paragraphs.en: "Wearing its inspirations on its sleeve, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 paints itself into the pantheon of great RPGs with a brilliant combat system and a gripping, harrowing story," IGN wrote in our Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 review , dubbing it a "modern RPG classic."
paragraphs.cn: IGN在《光与影：33号远征队》评测中写道：「《光与影：33号远征队》毫不掩饰自己的灵感来源，凭借出色的战斗系统和扣人心弦、令人心碎的故事，将自己绘入了伟大RPG的殿堂。」IGN称其为「现代RPG经典」。
